title: Legora Launches Skills, Pre-Built and Custom Instructions for Its AI Agent
key_facts: Legora announced Legora Skills on Monday
Skills are premade and custom-built instructions for the AI agent
Launch library has more than 250 skills built by Legora's legal engineers
Examples: first-pass contract review, nondisclosure agreement triage, chronology creation
Customers can build skills through natural language chat, based on previous work product
Comes as OpenAI and Anthropic also release skill-based tools
quote_evidence: Legal artificial intelligence company Legora announced Monday the launch of Legora Skills, premade and custom-built instructions that tell Legora’s AI agent how to perform specific tasks.

Skills launched with a library containing more than 250 skills pre-built by Legora’s legal engineers, and customers can build their own skills through the agent’s natural language chat interface and based on previous work product.
why_it_matters_hint: Reusable instructions let legal teams capture their firm's way of working.
notes: Announced Monday 5 Oct 2026 per Law.com: score lowered by 1 (6 to 5). Article text was short (teaser only).
